      public SELF child(Object value)
      Adds a child element to this element.
      Parameters:
      value - The child to add as a child element. Can be a string or HtmlElement. Can also be a container of strings and elements. Can be null (a null entry is added to the children list).
      Returns:
      This object.

    • children

      public SELF children(Object... value)
      Adds one or more child elements to this element.
      Parameters:

      This object.

    • getChild

      public Object getChild(int... index)
      Returns the child node at the specified address.

      Indexes are zero-indexed.

      For example, calling getChild(1,2,3); will return the 4th child of the 3rd child of the 2nd child.

      Parameters:
      index - The child indexes.
      Returns:
      The child node, or null if it doesn't point to a valid child.
